task.title: Developer API documentation usability test
task.description: A developer follows our public API quickstart in an isolated sandbox using test credentials only. Record unclear steps, completion or blockers, and reproducible errors. No production changes or real payments.
task.acceptanceCriteria: A step log, reproducible blockers, environment details and at least three specific documentation improvements.

blockers.observation: The example does not explain where to obtain sandbox credentials.

sampleResult.suggestion: Link to test credential instructions before step 3.
